description: Post-review polish fixes: CSS-only hamburger menu for mobile, backdrop-filter fallback, animation visibility safety net, and structural documentation comment for dark mode.
steps: Add a CSS-only hamburger menu using a second checkbox hack for mobile nav accessibility
Add @supports not (backdrop-filter: blur(1px)) fallback for .navbar and .hero-content
Add animation visibility safety fallback so sections do not remain invisible if animations fail
Add a comment documenting the dark mode structural constraint (checkbox must remain a direct sibling of nav, main, footer)
acceptance_criteria: Mobile users can access navigation links via hamburger menu toggle
Browsers without backdrop-filter support get opaque backgrounds for .navbar and .hero-content
Sections are guaranteed visible even if animation execution fails
A code comment documents the dark mode sibling selector constraint
Existing dark mode and responsive behavior remain intact
verification: Run 'cat site1/index.html | grep -c "<script" ' to verify no JavaScript (should output 0)
Run 'grep -c "backdrop-filter" site1/style.css' to verify @supports block exists
Run 'grep -c "hamburger" site1/style.css' to confirm hamburger styles are present
findings: All 4 review issues addressed. Hamburger menu uses the same checkbox hack pattern as dark mode - a second hidden input that toggles .mobile-nav-panel visibility via sibling combinator. The panel is display:none on desktop, display:flex on mobile (hidden via transform/opacity), and slides in when checked. The @supports not block covers .navbar, .hero-content, .project-badge, and .project-stats. The animation-fill-mode:forwards is already in the shorthand but added as an explicit property for defense in depth. Dark mode structural constraint documented in both HTML comment and CSS comment.
